§ 301-72.301 Processing unused, partially used, and exchanged tickets.
§ 301-72.301 Processing unused, partially used, and exchanged tickets.
(a) 
For unused or partially used tickets purchased with GTRs.
(b) 
For unused or partially used tickets purchased under centrally billed accounts.
(c) 
For exchanged tickets purchased with GTRs.
